Android TV and Google TV don't let you choose a Home app. Phone TV can step in front of the stock home screen whenever it appears, including when you press the Home button.

Turn on "Phone TV home" under Accessibility:
• Shield and Android TV: Settings › Device Preferences › Accessibility
• Google TV: Settings › System › Accessibility

Phone TV only checks which app is on screen; it never reads what's on it.

If your box has no Accessibility menu, use ADB instead:
adb shell settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services %1$s
adb shell settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1

Experimental: system updates can block this. Turn it off the same way.

Fire TV doesn't let you choose a Home app. Phone TV can step in front of the Fire TV home screen whenever it appears, including when you press the Home button.

Fire TV hides the Accessibility menu this needs, so turn it on with ADB (Settings › My Fire TV › Developer options › ADB debugging):
adb shell settings put secure enabled_accessibility_services %1$s
adb shell settings put secure accessibility_enabled 1

Phone TV only checks which app is on screen; it never reads what's on it.

Send my setup to another device
Your Library, saved actors, history and settings go straight to another device on the same Wi-Fi. Nothing to install. Sign-ins stay here.

On your other device, open Phone TV › Settings › Send my setup to another device. Both must be on the same home network; Wi-Fi and cable both work.

That code doesn\'t match. Check the other screen.

resources.string: Phone TV\'s player plays what your Stremio add-ons find. Add one by its link, or bring over your Stremio account\'s add-ons, in Settings › Add-ons.
Stremio add-ons for sources, subtitles and extra rows.
Paste one link, or a whole list (from Nuvio, for example).
Sign in with a code and copy every add-on on your Stremio account.
Phone TV comes with no add-ons. What an add-on offers is up to the add-on and you.
Paste the add-on\'s link. Several links at once work too, one per line.
Scan this with your phone\'s camera and sign in to Stremio there. Or open link.stremio.com on any phone or computer and enter the code. Phone TV only reads your add-on list.
Connected to Stremio. Reading your add-ons…

From the beginning plays what\'s on from its start, or the next title when 20 minutes or less are left. Joining where the channel is works in Phone TV\'s own player.

This copy of Phone TV runs inside an emulator (such as BlueStacks), which other devices can\'t connect to.\n\nDo it the other way round: choose Send on the other device, then Get setup from another device here and type the address it shows.

On your other device, open Phone TV › Settings › Send my setup to another device. Then type the address it shows below. An emulator (such as BlueStacks) can\'t see other devices by itself, but it can reach one by its address.
